message:
Not sure what to do first? Here's when each wedding task is due, counted back from your date:

• Agree on your top priorities: about 14 months out
• Book the venue: 10 months
• Book the photographer: 9 months
• Send save-the-dates: 6 months
• Mail invitations: about 10 weeks before

Add your wedding date to our free checklist and all 59 steps get a due date, with anything you're behind on flagged.
